3.name: Design-only KBs (6 per-layer)
3.scope: KB-frontend-design + KB-backend-design + KB-api-design + KB-query-design + KB-database-design + KB-iac-design
3.approach: Fresh authoring (no prior-skill seeds). Each KB follows a uniform structure: SKILL.md (router with frontmatter / Contents checklist / When-loaded section listing referencing sub-agents / responsibility / decisions / patterns at-a-glance / interaction with other layers / Q-<LAYER>-N surfacing template / routing to references) + references/principles.md (8 foundational principles for the layer) + references/patterns-and-anti-patterns.md (common patterns with when-to-use + ~20-row anti-patterns table + decision frames). Design-discipline-only — platform-specific knowledge (framework idioms, engine syntax) defers to per-run Synthesis output.

KB-frontend-design.principles: separate server/client state; colocate-then-lift; WCAG 2.2 AA baseline; concrete LCP/INP/CLS budgets; progressive enhancement; error boundaries scoped to recovery; typed contracts; framework grain
KB-frontend-design.patterns: smart/dumb, compound, render-props, hooks; local/context/store/server-state-lib; fetch-in-effects, parallel-at-route-boundaries, optimistic+rollback; controlled vs. uncontrolled forms; SSR/SSG/ISR/CSR/streaming; 16-row anti-patterns

KB-backend-design.principles: bounded contexts; hexagonal/ports-and-adapters with ASCII diagram; idempotency-by-default with 5-strategy table; errors-as-first-class with categories/envelope/retriability; transactions scoped to data store (saga/outbox/2PC alternatives); observability (logs/metrics/traces) at design time; explicit concurrency model; external calls = timeout+retry+circuit-breaker
KB-backend-design.patterns: monolith/modular-monolith/microservices; repository/UoW/ActiveRecord/CQRS; single-tx/saga/outbox/2PC/read-after-write; anemic vs rich domain/aggregates/event-sourcing; idempotency-key middleware; feature flags; 19-row anti-patterns

KB-api-design.principles: contract-as-commitment; pessimistic versioning; stable error envelope (RFC 7807 shape); Idempotency-Key contract; cursor pagination; HTTP semantics table (methods + status codes); auth at edge not sprinkled; generated docs not hand-written
KB-api-design.patterns: REST/GraphQL/gRPC/hybrid; REST resource modeling (collection+item, sub-resources, action endpoints, sparse fieldsets); GraphQL (per-domain types, Connections pagination, Input types, field-auth); gRPC (unary/server-stream/client-stream/bidi); URL/header/never-break versioning; cursor/offset/time-based pagination; per-actor/per-endpoint/per-tenant rate limits with headers; 21-row anti-patterns

KB-query-design.principles: eager-load-by-intent (with N+1 example); projections-not-SELECT-*; cache discipline (keys/TTL/invalidation/stampede); read/write split with primary routing; statement timeouts table by query class; bulk operations beat per-row; repository as interface; read models when reads diverge
KB-query-design.patterns: raw SQL / query builder / ORM / embedded; N+1 prevention (JOIN / batch / DataLoader / window functions); caching (cache-aside / write-through / write-around / read-through / TTL-only / refresh-ahead); cursor/offset/seek pagination; materialized view / CQRS projection / search index; batched insert / COPY / upsert / chunked iteration; 19-row anti-patterns

KB-database-design.principles: constraints-at-DB (NOT NULL/UNIQUE/FK/CHECK/exclusion); atomic-reversible-zero-downtime migrations (expand-then-contract pattern with NOT NULL/rename/type-change sequences); indexes for actual queries (composite/partial/expression/covering); UTC everywhere (Postgres timestamptz); hard-delete by default with soft-delete discipline; audit columns (created_at/updated_at/created_by/updated_by); decimal-for-money (NUMERIC(19,4)); opaque externally-addressable IDs (UUIDv4/v7/ULID/NanoID)
KB-database-design.patterns: normalization/denormalization, polymorphism (avoid), JSONB (use sparingly), event tables; B-tree/composite/partial/expression/covering/GIN/BRIN indexes; expand-contract sequences, CONCURRENTLY index, batched backfill, dual-write rename; multi-tenancy (shared-schema-tenant-column / schema-per-tenant / DB-per-tenant); range/list/hash partitioning; CHECK/EXCLUSION/deferred constraints; 20-row anti-patterns

KB-iac-design.principles: state as source of truth (never edit by hand); plan-before-apply always; idempotency by design; blast-radius minimization (stack-per-environment, module-per-concern); drift detection scheduled; secrets never in state plaintext, OIDC for cloud auth; modules versioned semantically with consumer pinning; prefer declarative over local-exec
KB-iac-design.patterns: stack-per-environment, module-per-concern, stack-per-concern, workspaces; separate cloud accounts vs. single account; remote state with locking (S3+DynamoDB), TF Cloud/Pulumi Cloud, hosted runners (Spacelift, Atlantis); GitHub Actions OIDC, Atlantis, manual local apply; OIDC / external secret stores / SOPS / Sealed Secrets; scheduled drift detection with alerting; 21-row anti-patterns

KB-cc-design.patterns: primitive decision matrix; layered defense for safety; CLAUDE.md refactoring (move-to-skills, split-by-level); rule patterns (path-gated, unconditional); skill patterns (model-invocable, user-invocable, bundled-supporting-files); subagent patterns (research, restricted-tools, memory-enabled); hook patterns (lint-on-edit, block-dangerous, session-start); MCP scope patterns; plugin patterns; 21-row anti-patterns

KB-github-actions-design.principles: CI and CD are separate concerns; OIDC over long-lived credentials; concurrency-groups protect serial resources; Environments gate not just label; least privilege at token/runner/action; pin third-party actions to SHA; caches accelerate not source-of-truth; workflows tested like code
KB-github-actions-design.patterns: workflow composition (single CI, separate CI/CD, orchestrated); reusable workflow vs composite action vs custom JS/Docker action; concurrency (cancel-previous-on-PR, serialize-deploys-per-env, per-resource); environment topology (linear promotion, multi-region, per-PR ephemeral); deployment (rolling, blue-green, canary, immutable); matrix patterns with max-parallel and fail-fast; cache patterns (lockfile-keyed); 23-row anti-patterns

KB-codespaces-design.principles: lifecycle hooks have strict order and scope (onCreate/updateContent/postCreate/postStart/postAttach); prebuilds capture some hooks not others; only /workspaces persists across rebuild; right-size the machine class; secrets in Codespaces Secrets never in repo; Features for known tools Dockerfile for unknowns; port forwarding declared explicitly; dev environment != production environment
KB-codespaces-design.patterns: base mechanism (universal image, language-specific image, Dockerfile, docker-compose); lifecycle-command placement (updateContent for npm install, postCreate for first-time only, postStart for daemons, postAttach for banners); prebuild strategies (main-only, main+N-feature, none); multi-container (app+DB+cache, app+mocks); tool installation (Features, Dockerfile RUN, lifecycle install); secrets-and-config; monorepo patterns; 24-row anti-patterns

review-architecture-auditor.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate
review-architecture-auditor.responsibility: At Architecture Audit (after shared-document-reviewer passes the Blueprint), substantively audits Blueprint against synthesis claims, codebase facts, inherited ADRs. Performs brief-honor L3 checks per ADR-0009 (decision contradiction; open-item handling; re-surfaced verified issue). Blast-radius analysis via GitNexus MCP (codebase-memory-mcp fallback). 7 phases: read inputs → L3 checks → blast-radius audit → synthesis-claim verification → cross-section consistency → author issues JSON → TaskUpdate. Severity rules: BLOCKER→fail, MAJOR→conditional_pass, MINOR/INFO→pass. 4-round convergence cap.

review-cross-artifact-auditor.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate
review-cross-artifact-auditor.responsibility: At Cross-Artifact Audit, checks consistency across Blueprint + Plan + Acceptance Tests + Phase Validators. Three distinguishing properties: (1) CMC posture (opus); (2) diff-mode input — does NOT see full upstream context, only diffs + new artifacts (prevents context bloat across 4-cycle reconciliation); (3) convergence-based termination + 4-cycle hard cap. 6 phases: diff-mode reading → 5 pairwise consistency checks (BP↔Plan, BP↔ATs, BP↔PVs, Plan↔ATs, Plan↔PVs) → convergence check → 4-cycle cap handling → author issues JSON → TaskUpdate.

plan-author.responsibility: Plan Authoring stage. Reads approved Blueprint + PRD + ADRs + codebase-analysis.json; produces plan-v<N>.md per canonical template. Plan-internal phases: Phase 0 (Setup), Phase 1..N (Feature Delivery; sequenced by dependency order, risk order, demonstrability), Phase N+1 (Rollout). Per-phase content: goal, scope, prerequisites, numbered tasks with layer/complexity/parallelizability/dependencies, feature flag state at end, verification reference, rollback path, estimated effort. Cross-phase: dependency graph, critical path, parallelization opportunities, risk register per phase, open dependencies for user, AC-to-Phase mapping table (exhaustive).

test-acceptance-author.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate
test-acceptance-author.responsibility: Acceptance Test Authoring stage. Reads PRD + Blueprint; maps every EARS-format AC to one or more concrete tests. Per test: ID, maps_to_AC provenance, name, type (unit/integration/contract/E2E/property/load following test pyramid — lowest level that genuinely verifies), layer of verification, preconditions, steps (AAA-structured), expected outcome (concrete/assertable), negative-path coverage, data dependencies, determinism notes. Coverage matrix audit: every AC has ≥1 test; no orphan tests; weak coverage flagged.

test-phase-validator-author.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate
test-phase-validator-author.responsibility: Phase Validator Authoring stage. Reads approved Plan + PRD + Blueprint (+ acceptance-tests.md if test-acceptance-author already wrote it). Authors one validator entry per Plan phase: validator ID (PV-N), phase reference, validator goal, pass criteria (each with assertion + source + automation hook), acceptance tests scheduled for the phase, operational checks (per-phase-type-specific), severity rules (blocking/warning/informational), failure response with rollback reference, validator metadata. Cross-validator: dependency graph, critical-path validators, parallelizable checks, shared infrastructure, runbook.

finalize-reconciler.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate
finalize-reconciler.responsibility: Reconciliation stage. Consumes issues JSON from shared-document-reviewer or review-architecture-auditor or review-cross-artifact-auditor; categorizes each issue by target sub-agent for re-authoring (PRD→intake-prd-author; Blueprint→design-composer; per-layer Design→design-<layer>; Plan→plan-author; ATs→test-acceptance-author; PVs→test-phase-validator-author); detects user-escalation issues; applies upstream-first dispatch ordering; runs convergence check (persistent issues across cycles); handles 4-cycle hard cap; authors reconciliation log (human-readable) + dispatch.json (machine-readable for orchestrator). Does NOT re-author any artifact itself.

finalize-task-decomposer.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate
finalize-task-decomposer.responsibility: Task Decomposition stage — pipeline's terminal authoring sub-agent. Consumes PRD + Blueprint + ADRs + Plan + Acceptance Tests + Phase Validators + codebase-analysis.json. Decomposes Plan tasks into work units (split L tasks; preserve coherence; size for assignability). Infers dependency edges (explicit from Plan + implicit from artifact deltas + cross-task data flow + phase boundary edges). Generates verification-aligned tasks (test-implementation per AT; validator-setup + validator-execution per PV). Computes critical path + parallelization opportunities. Outputs tasks.json conforming to canonical schema v1.0.0 from KB-task-decomposition.
